chunks: Remember, when he said to his father: "O my father, why do you worship that which can neither hear nor see nor even profit you the least?"
ai.seo_question: What are the three characteristics of idols that Prophet Ibrahim highlighted in his argument against his father?
ai.summary: In Surah Maryam, this verse highlights Prophet Ibrahim’s rational critique of idolatry, emphasizing the sensory and functional impotence of idols. Shia scholars often view this as a foundational argument for Tawhid, illustrating the logical necessity of worshipping a sentient, all-powerful Creator. The dialogue underscores the transition from ancestral tradition to reasoned monotheism.
